_comment: Production split plan for the Victor2 FYP proposal corpus in proposal\sections. Run from this folder: node convert.js --config split-plan.fyp.json . Relative paths resolve against this config file's directory, so outputs land in the workspace root D:\File\School\FYP. The corpus has NO '# ' H1 headings; its top-level sections are '## N. Title'. convert.js derives the section boundary from the document's shallowest heading level, so the include rules below match the '## N.' keys directly. 'titlePage': true synthesises a real title page and a TOC field for a document that has no H1 to promote.
author: Victor Li
